validation_notes: The right side of the chart shows a sharp selloff (gap down to ~15) followed by a strong V-shaped recovery to ~18.7 on heavy volume, then a slight pullback. The algorithm likely misread the sharp bounce as the start of a descending triangle, but there's no repeated testing of a support level or series of lower highs compressing toward it.
